title: Russian Pepper Pilaf
description: A flavorful and hearty pilaf dish inspired by Russian cuisine, featuring tender peppers and savory spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add diced peppers and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with onions and peppers.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until rice starts to lightly toast.
Add pilaf spice blend and black pepper, stir to combine.
Transfer mixture to a medium saucepan and add 1 1/2 cups water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes.
Fluff cooked rice with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with additional chopped peppers or fresh herbs, if desired.
